verdict: Plays clean: cleared, no console error, every spot reachable in both states of the paths; the wisps, the roots, the rival (Vesper), the trial, the ruler (the Moss Warden, in the Elder's model) and the gate (Nyx; second try) all played. One quest's words fixed.

found.title: “The Lost Spade” asked for a bundle
found.text: The Wood's maker names the camp giver's second quest “The Lost Spade”, “The Lost Lantern” or “The Lost Bundle”, but its words always spoke of a bundle. Now the thing dropped, carried and named on the HUD is the one in the quest's name (src/tower/world/gen/wood.ts; floors 12 to 20 re-baked: only those words changed, on seven floors; it is still drawn as a bundle in the hand).

found.text: As on floor 11: the trees are the cover; spore motes in the air; trees on the hills past the edge. Nothing out of place by eye.
